Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, artifacts, posters, or applications (examples include websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, or when styling/beautifying any web UI). Generates creative, polished code and UI design that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
skills.author: Anthropic

description_v2.en: Build distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with polished UI design that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
description_v2.ja: 没個性なAIデザインを避けた、洗練された本番品質のフロントエンドインターフェースを構築します。
description_v2.zh-cn: 构建具有独特风格、生产级质量的前端界面，避免千篇一律的 AI 审美。

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.
skills.author: Anthropic

description_v2.en: Test and debug local web applications using Playwright, with support for screenshots and browser log inspection.
description_v2.ja: Playwright を使用してローカル Web アプリをテスト・デバッグし、スクリーンショットやブラウザログの確認に対応します。
description_v2.zh-cn: 使用 Playwright 对本地 Web 应用进行测试与调试，支持截图和浏览器日志查看。
